title: HTCE: Homeomorphism-inspired Topological Cross-Scene Experience Canonicalization and Reuse for Object Navigation
title_zh: HTCE：面向物体导航的同胚启发式拓扑跨场景经验规范化与复用

paragraphs.en: HTCE通过同胚启发的拓扑规范化导航经验，实现跨场景复用，显著提升物体目标导航成功率与效率。 As embodied agents perform object-goal navigation across residential environments, they accumulate successful experiences whose semantic structure recurs across scenes even when geometric trajectories do not. Reusing such experience is challenging because differences in region naming and observation granularity produce distinct graph representations of similar approaches, while meaningful differences in anchors, branches, and endpoints must stay distinguishable. We introduce HTCE, a homeomorphism-inspired topological framework that canonicalizes and reuses navigation experience. Feature and topology subdivisions characterize representational variations, and their semantically constrained reductions produce comparable semantic sequences and structural signatures while preserving semantic anchors, branching relations, and navigation endpoints. HTCE then retrieves historical successful approaches through subdivision-aware matching as guidance for a frozen vision-language policy. Canonicalization compresses the experience index losslessly, merging 17.7--23.6\% of distinct stored route descriptions while retaining full task performance. Under a single frozen vision-language backbone shared by all compared systems, HTCE attains the best SR and SPL in every setting---59.9\%/31.8\% on HM3D v0.1, 71.0\%/31.5\% on HM3D v0.2, and 46.6\%/16.6\% on MP3D---with SR gains of up to 4.9 points and structured retrieval contributing up to 2.8 SPL points. The code is available in https://github.com/startracker0/htce.git
paragraphs.zh: HTCE通过同胚启发的拓扑规范化来导航经验，实现跨场景复用，显著提升物体目标导航的成功率与效率。随着具身智能体在住宅环境中执行物体目标导航，它们会积累成功经验，即使几何轨迹不同，这些经验的语义结构也会在不同场景中重复出现。 复用此类经验具有挑战性，因为区域命名和观察粒度的差异会为相似的路径产生不同的图表示，而锚点、分支和终点上有意义的差异必须保持可区分。 我们提出HTCE，一个同胚启发的拓扑框架，用于规范化和复用导航经验。 特征与拓扑细分刻画了表示上的变化，其受语义约束的约简在保留语义锚点、分支关系和导航终点的同时，产生可比较的语义序列与结构签名。 HTCE随后通过感知细分的匹配检索历史成功路径，作为冻结视觉-语言策略的指导。 规范化无损地压缩了经验索引，合并了17.7--23.6\%的不同已存路径描述，同时保持完整的任务性能。 在所有对比系统共享同一冻结视觉-语言骨干的条件下，HTCE在每种设置中都取得最优的SR与SPL——HM3D v0.1上为59.9\%/31.8\%，HM3D v0.2上为71.0\%/31.5\%，MP3D上为46.6\%/16.6\%——SR提升最高达4.9个百分点，结构化检索贡献最高达2.8个SPL点。 代码可在 https://github.com/startracker0/htce.git 获取。
